author: GameTrailers
description: Check out this trailer for Hope in the City, an upcoming narrative mystery game from developer Lofty Sky Entertainment Inc. When 17-year-old Hope Song comes home to find her parents gone, she refuses to wait for answers; she becomes the investigator herself. Hope in the City will be available on PC via Steam, and a demo is out now on Steam.
title: Hope In The City - Official Demo Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Join the developers of Above: Colonies of the Mist for a deep dive into the gameplay and more from this upcoming vertical colony sim game. Learn about challenges you'll face and strategies you'll need to survive. Above: Colonies of the Mist will be available on PC. Sign-ups for a playtest are available via Steam.

In Above: Colonies of the Mist, build a hilltop colony in the last land safe from the toxic mist. Survive, expand, explore ancient monuments, and look for a way out before the mist claims everything.
title: Above: Colonies of the Mist - Official Dev Commentary Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Gameplay Trailer for Anomaly Express, a co-op psychological horror game developed by NAC Games. Players will set out on a cursed winter train in the name of survival, alone or with friends. Face anomalies and uncover the supernatural in Anomaly Express, coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Anomaly Express - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Lootbound DLC Launch Trailer for SOS OPS!, a third-person, physics-driven co-op game developed by ArtDock. Players can check out the new roguelite mode that brings new content into the chaos. The Lootbound DLC for SOS OPS! is available now for PC (Steam).
title: SOS OPS! - Official Lootbound DLC Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the PS5 Announcement Trailer for Hubert, a story-driven action-adventure game developed by Brocap Studio. Players will embody a loyal shepherd named Hubert to gather the flock of sheep, take in gorgeous landscapes, and track scents as necessary. Hubert is coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5) and PC (Steam).
title: Hubert - Official PS5 Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at Nightmare Shift in this trailer for the upcoming psychological horror game that takes you to a mysterious motel. Take on the role of Emma, who feels she is being watched and struggles to tell the line between reality and nightmare. Nightmare Shift will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5) on August 13, 2026. It is also available now on PC and Xbox Series X/S.
title: Nightmare Shift - Official PlayStation 5 (PS5) Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a behind-the-scenes look at Stranger Than Heaven in this latest trailer for the upcoming action-adventure game. Stranger Than Heaven is a fifty-year, action-adventure saga of men with nowhere to go and their desperate struggle to find a home. Use extreme violence to survive, and musical talent to thrive as a showman across five cities and eras of modern Japan. Stranger Than Heaven will be available on Xbox Series X/S, Xbox on PC, Xbox Cloud, Steam, and PlayStation 5 (PS5) on January 15, 2027.
title: Stranger Than Heaven - Official Development Behind-The-Scenes Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Into the Abyss Update Full Trailer for Grounded 2, the hit action-adventure base-building game developed by Obsidian Entertainment and Eidos Montreal. Players can take an extensive look at the biggest update with a new pond area to explore, deadly creatures to engage, and new gear to brave the depths of the park. The Into the Abyss Update for Grounded 2 is launching on August 11 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Grounded 2 - Official Into the Abyss Update Full Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Midnight Curse of Ula’tek Launch Trailer for World of Warcraft, the legendary MMO RPG developed by Blizzard Entertainment. Players can now gain access to a new content update to seek the anomalies of the Coiled Isle. Take on new dangers and overcome challenges in the Midnight Curse of Ula’tek Update for World of Warcraft, launching on August 11 for PC (Steam).
title: World of Warcraft - Official Midnight Curse of Ula’tek Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Obakeidoro 2: Chase & Seek is available now on Nintendo Switch and Nintendo Switch 2. Watch the Obakeidoro 2: Chase & Seek launch trailer for this asymmetric tag game. Obakeidoro 2: Chase & Seek invites players into an eerie world inspired by traditional Japanese legends for a thrilling game of cat-and-mouse.
title: Obakeidoro 2: Chase & Seek - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Season 4: Heroes of Busan Trailer for Overwatch, the hit first-person action hero shooter developed by Blizzard. Players can take a look at what's in store with Season 4, packed with the new Tank Hero D.Mon, new events, challenges, rewards, and more. Progress through the Battle Passes of Season 4: Heroes of Busan in Overwatch, launching on August 11 for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam and Battle.Net).
title: Overwatch - Official Season 4: Heroes of Busan Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Launch Trailer for Bottle Cracks, a physics-based party game platformer developed by Alunova Studios. Players will embody simple bottles tasked with enduring difficult levels without cracking under the pressure. Don't break the bottle in Bottle Cracks, available now for PC (Steam).
title: Bottle Cracks - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
A warrior's greatest burden may not be the blade at their side, but the purpose behind it. Watch the latest Shadow of the Road trailer to learn about the beginning of the story of the upcoming story-driven, turn-based RPG. In Shadow of the Road, feudal Japan meets magic and machine. Assemble your team from a diverse set of characters and test your skills against yōkai and steampunk contraptions. Carve your own path through an immersive story and change the fate of the Empire.

Shadow of the Road will be available on PC (GOG, Steam, and Epic Games Store). A demo is out now.
title: Shadow of the Road - Official Nippon Divided: Story Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Broken Rain Incursion Trailer for The Division 2, the third-person action shooter developed by Ubisoft. Players can take on a new Incursion called Broken Rain, which tasks Agents with reclaiming a facility before certain doom from an incoming hurricane. Take on new bosses and earn rewards in the Broken Rain Incursion for The Division 2, launching on August 11 for PlayStation 4 (PS4), Xbox One, and PC (Steam).
title: The Division 2 - Official Broken Rain Incursion Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Vision: Cloud Trailer for Final Fantasy Resonance, an upcoming pixel-based HD 2D RPG developed by Square Enix and Lancarse. Players can resonate with the Vision of the legendary Cloud Strife, Soldier First Class from Final Fantasy 7. Learn more about the iconic figure in gaming history and make use of his abilities in combat. Fight alongside Cloud in Final Fantasy Resonance, launching on October 22 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).
title: Final Fantasy Resonance - Official Vision: Cloud Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get a fresh look at gameplay, residents, and more from Village in the Shade in this latest trailer for the upcoming hand-painted farming sim. Village in the Shade will be available on Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and PC on October 27, 2026.

Welcome to Kagatsu, a beautiful mountain town in rural Japan perfect for a change of pace! Meet the local townsfolk, hunt, mine, plant crops, and explore in Village in the Shade.

Just don't go out at night. You never know who (or what) you'll run into...

This is quiet, countryside living...as long as you follow the rules.
title: Village in the Shade - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Don't miss the Medic Class Trailer for Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2, an upcoming third-person action shooter developed by Cold Iron Studios. Players can get an overview of the game's Medic Class, packed with abilities to keep the team alive amidst the horrors to face. Survive with the Medic Class in Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2, launching on August 25 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).

#AliensFireteamElite2 #Gaming #IGN
title: Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2 - Official Medic Class Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the 'Kill Block' From The Ward Ep. 6 Video for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, the latest addition to the first-person action shooter franchise developed by Infinity Ward. Players can get a behind-the-scenes look at the Fanatics Fest event where players got their hands on Kill Block, an upcoming and ever-shifting map offering over 500 different variations. Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is launching on October 23 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).
title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 - Official 'Kill Block' From The Ward Ep. 6

author: GameTrailers
description: First-person psychological Chinese horror game Hariti drops its creepiest trailer yet as it prepares for its August 11 launch on Steam. You'll play a mother searching for her missing daughter in an abandoned (or so it seems) hospital. Check it out on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4018740/Hariti/
title: Hariti: Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Join co-founder and executive producer Jean-Francois Boivin from developer Panache Digital Games for a deep dive into investigation mechanics and more of 1666: Amsterdam in this new video for the upcoming third-person action-adventure game. 1666: Amsterdam launches into Early Access on PC via Steam and Epic Games Store on August 25, 2026.

In this new video, we also get a dive into the day and night cycle, combat, your objectives, Noa's mystical abilities, Aaron's feline gameplay and how the characters combine their unique skills to uncover hidden truths and restore the balance of the world.
title: 1666: Amsterdam - Official Day & Night Cycle: Game Feature Video #3

author: GameTrailers
description: Repterra leaves early access and version 1.0 will be available on Steam on August 20, 2026. Get another look at gameplay, large-scale battles, upgraded visuals, and the world of Repterra in this latest teaser for the base-building survival RTS game. In Repterra, rebuild civilization in a world overrun by dinosaurs. Construct sprawling colonies, develop powerful economies, tame and breed dinosaurs, lead heroes into battle, and survive against overwhelming prehistoric hordes.
title: Repterra - Official Version 1.0 Release Date Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Launch Trailer for Runt, a decision-based visual novel developed by Grimtaste Studios. Players will investigate an unsettling message that sends an entire town into complete fear and disarray. Make key dialogue choices, seek out clues, and uncover the truth before the message comes to pass. Runt is available now for PC (Steam).
title: Runt - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the 'Fierce & Lethal' Trailer for Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy, an upcoming third-person action-adventure game developed by Focus Entertainment. Players can get a general overview of the game's in-depth combat system, which requires players to chain sword attacks, parry attacks, dodge enemies, and keep the pressure up in any battle. Fight admirably in Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy, launching on August 27 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy - Official 'Fierce & Lethal' Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Liino Operator Story Trailer for Arknights: Endfield, the hit action RPG developed by Hypergryph. Players can become familiar with Liino, a new operator in the game that's set to bring a pop flare to the battlefield. Check out Liino's bubbly personality in Arknights: Endfield, available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), iOS, Android, and PC (Steam).
title: Arknights: Endfield - Official Liino Operator Story Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Launch Trailer for Sovereign Tower, a decision-based management RPG developed by Wild Wits Games. Players will take up the task of recruiting Knights, taking on quests, and rewriting fate to seek the desired destiny of the kingdom itself. Sovereign Tower is available now for PC (Steam).
title: Sovereign Tower - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's your look at the 10 Million Pixels announcement trailer for this upcoming incremental mining game about exploration and erosion. Mine through millions of pixels to find the one golden pixel. 10 Million Pixels will be available on PC via Steam.
title: 10 Million Pixels - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Lethal Tool Feature Trailer for Restitched, an arcade platformer developed by Trixel Creative. Players will take on level after level to overcome platforming obstacles and endure lethal traps to provide a deeper challenge. Become electrocuted, burned, frozen, and more in Restitched, coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Restitched - Official Lethal Tool Feature Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Spain vs. France Gameplay Trailer for Captain Tsubasa 2: World Fighters, an upcoming third-person action football (soccer) game developed by Tamsoft Corporation. Players can get an extensive look at an enthralling match that pits Spain and France against each other in the beautiful game of the world. See who takes the victory in Captain Tsubasa 2: World Fighters, launching on August 28 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Captain Tsubasa 2: World Fighters - Official Spain vs. France Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Watch the latest Jurassic World Evolution 3: Crocodilia Coast trailer for another look at the five species available in the upcoming expansion for the dinosaur park management game. The Jurassic World Evolution 3: Crocodilia Coast pack features five family units and a collection of coastal themed scenery pieces to expand your waterside operations. Jurassic World Evolution 3 is available now on PC, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X|S. The Crocodilia Coast pack for Jurassic World Evolution 3 will be available on August 11, 2026.

In Jurassic World Evolution 3, build your own Jurassic World. Nurture generations of dinosaurs with the series debut of juveniles, create and manage sprawling prehistoric parks around the globe, and let your imagination roar with powerful new creative options.
title: Jurassic World Evolution 3: Crocodilia Coast - Official Species Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Meet the Desmatosuchus in this latest Jurassic World Evolution 3: Crocodilia Coast trailer for the upcoming expansion for the dinosaur park management game. A distant relative of modern crocodiles, the herbivorous Desmatosuchus is effective at deterring potential predators with its large shoulder spikes and a carapace formed with two rows of bony scutes. Jurassic World Evolution 3 is available now on PC, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X|S. The Crocodilia Coast pack for Jurassic World Evolution 3 will be available on August 11, 2026.

The Jurassic World Evolution 3: Crocodilia Coast pack features 5 family units and a collection of coastal-themed scenery pieces to expand your waterside operations.

In Jurassic World Evolution 3, build your own Jurassic World. Nurture generations of dinosaurs with the series debut of juveniles, create and manage sprawling prehistoric parks around the globe, and let your imagination roar with powerful new creative options.
title: Jurassic World Evolution 3: Crocodilia Coast - Official Desmatosuchus Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Mobile Announcement Trailer for Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed, the hit action platformer game developed by Purple Lamp. Players will embark on a classic Disney adventure optimized for mobile platforms. Overcome platforming challenges across the Wasteland, take on bosses, and take the adventure on the go. Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed is coming soon to iOS and Android.
title: Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed - Official Mobile Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's your look at the Sin Or Suffer announcement trailer for this upcoming story-rich survival-horror JRPG. In Sin Or Suffer, enter a brutal medieval prison overrun by violent convicts, shocking corruption and something far more disturbing beneath its walls. Sin Or Suffer will be available on PC via Steam in 2027.
title: Sin Or Suffer - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the new Heist Escape Roguelike Payday Experience in Fortnite, the hit third-person battle royale game developed by Epic Games. Players can now take on an all-new heist experience that sees intense gunfights, a suite of weapons, and plenty of loot to escape with at all costs. Head back for another run in Heist Escape Roguelike Payday Experience in Fortnite, available now.
title: Heist Escape Roguelike - Official Payday Experience Launch Trailer (Created in Fortnite)

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the latest No Man's Sky trailer as the sci-fi action-adventure exploration shooter game celebrates its 10th anniversary. The latest trailer looks back at ten years of updates, from No Man's Sky Beyond through the upcoming No Man's Sky Cosmos update.

No Man's Sky is available now on PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), PlayStation VR 2 (PSVR2), VR, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, macOS, and PC (Steam).
title: No Man's Sky - Official 10th Anniversary Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the latest Genshin Impact trailer "Alyosha: Wintry Hunt" for the action RPG. Genshin Impact is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, iOS, Android, and PC.
title: Genshin Impact - Official "Alyosha: Wintry Hunt" Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Tavrik gets a new trailer showcasing gameplay and a release date. Check out the latest Tavrik trailer for this upcoming strategy roguelike game. In Tavrik every journey is shaped by the cards you play. Build roads across procedurally generated maps, reshape the terrain, construct useful structures, and place helpful characters while carefully managing your limited energy. Adapt your deck and plan efficient routes as wildlife, disasters, and escalating threats stand between you and the next exit. Players will keep their wits about them while the map changes beneath their feet. Tavrik will be available on PC (Steam) on August 31, 2026.
title: Tavrik - Official Release Date Trailer
